claim: Patchline ships a negative-results registry with a reproducible experiment for every claimed boundary. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the negative-results registry claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make negative-results-registry-gate`.
